book.name: Honowok Nair
book.title: Roh Kudus Nin Honowok Nair Lolo Hophopon Ma Nodi Yesus Lirnenihe

content: Makromod Lalap nala Roh Kudus naikoro ma akin naili'il Yesus honorok akin
Rakanedi lere alam lalapa ma naran Pentakosta ne, ri ma akin naili'il Yesus enihe na'akeme raikokoro wuku lolo onnida.
Hi raikokoro wuku ne, ramlilinnohi hir derne haida neknekir nano wawan naisa opil lape. Ha hir dederne onne nekir mamani lolo nakar hir miminle raram na'akeme.
Hir po'onnala haida naisa ai lere man anna hu lalaa mamai nalwali hi dohdoho.
Makromod Lalap nala Roh Kudus naikoro hi honorok akin, idewe Roh Kudus nala woroin hi leke wakunu noho-noho namehin rira wanakunu.
Ler onne ri Yahudi ma namka'uk Makromod Lalap nano hair-hair lolo noho wawan na'akeme aile Yerusalem.
Hir derne ha man neknekir onneni ne, hir maiwuku me'e. Hir derne ri ma akin naili'il Yesus enihe dohdoho wakunkunu hirira wanakunue, na'akeme polletilu la mehe nanana mouwedi.
Hi na'akeme hehel, la ida ma ne'el ida, “Heih! Ri man wakunkunu eniyenihe manina Galilea, ee ka?
Hi'ihepenia ika derne hir wakunu rodi iknika wanakunu rahue?
Maika eniyenihe ri ma nano noho Patria, Media, noro Elam, ma nano noho Mesapotamia, Yudea, noro Kapadokia, ma nano noho Pontus noro Asia,
ma nano noho Frigia noro Pamfilia, ma nano noho Mesir noro leke-leke lolo noho Libia ma na'uranrani leke Kirene, la maika heruwali mai nano Roma haenhi.

Maika heruwali ri Yahudi la heruwali ri ma ka namwali Yahudi man lernohiyedi Yahudi rira agame me'e, la ik heruwali ma nano noho Kreta noro Arab haenhi. Ik derne ri man wakunu onnenihe dohdoho rodi iknika wanakunu ra'aheni, ‘Makromod Lalap hi'iyedi ha man ik kak dedernale la kak dodo'onnale makun.’ ”
Hi na'akeme hehel rehi la mehe kakaiyedi, la ida ma na'ukani ida, “Ha ma namwali eniyenihe nina panaeku inhawe?”
Maa ri aile haenhi mahar hadwei hi ra'ahenia, “Ah, ri eniyenihe nadoo romun arak, de manha mouwedi me'e menee!”
Petrus loikaru Makromod Lalap Lirna Wawa'an eni

Petrus noro Yesus Nin hophopon idaweli ida ramririri wewerre, la an wakunu naruri laa heri onnenihe na'ahenia, “I walin Yahudi roro walin namehin man minle Yerusalem na'ahoru! Makaniyala wawa'an, ya a'amou a'aropo ha man mim dodo'on eniyeni.
Ri enihe ka romon arak, de kar manha naise mim pae'eku eni! Idedi nanumene riuk wohii al'alam menee!
Ka! Ha ma namwali eniyeni, Makromod Lalap konohiyedi lolo Nin nabi Yoel na'ahenia,

content.text: ‘Rakan ku lili'ur Ya ala Ainu'u Roh ri mormori na'akeme leke:
Mi anum mo'oni maeke lo'o konohi mi inhawa namwali lere man mai,
la minim mo'oni ma na'ikaka makun meher do'on haida-haida,
la minim ri leleher ramarmi.
Ler onne, Ya ala Roh Kudus ki Ainu'u hophopon wahwahan--mo'oni maeke, leke hir konohi ri namehin inhawa Ya'u pae'eku eni.
Ya'u hi'i tanada ri ka nadedem do'on lolo a'am eni, noro tanada ri ka nadedem do'on lolo noho wawan haenhi,
rara noro aiye, la ai mahu namansa haenhi.
Lere onne lere maki, la wollo namwali mere naisa rare.
Eniyeni namwali nolu mene Ainu'u Ler Alam Lalapa man ma'aruru wake'e mai.
Enla inhoi napanak Maya'u pakue,
ai onne lernala Ainu'u or'ori dardari ma kan horu.’

content: I wal'uhe ri Israel na'ahohoruwedi! Makaniyala wawa'an ainu'u panaeku eniyeni: Yesus, manin Nazaret onne, ik Makromod Lalap hopon mai min noro maika. Ik kauroin panaeku onne, ono Makromod Lalap nala molollo Ai leke An hi'iyedi ha man lewlewen noro tanada nammori man ik kak dodo'onnala makun. Ha onne na'akeme An hi'iyedi lolo mi herne kalarne, de i wal'uhe do'on la mauroinedi me'e.
Yesus onne, Makromod Lalap nala ki mi, maa mi mesnedie, mala kani ri man ailanna leke waire lolo au kekiyowok. Panaeku onne na'akeme Makromod Lalap nakakaredi nano nonolu me'e.
Enimaa Makromod Lalap huri Yesus nano makmaki nin apinpinha wo'operperi, ono makimaki ka naruri nodi molollo Yesus mamani.
Nonolu eni ik upud a'ad Daud konohiyedi ha ma namwali noro Yesus heheni,

content.text: ‘I do'on Makromod Lalap lolo Ya'u kalarna mamani,
Ai norle'ule'u norwaliwali Ya'u de, haida ka na'o'o nadewe Ya'u.
Enpenia Ya akin nahuwa'an, Ya a'uli asa'e mamani,
la ka amkauk inhawa namwali I kem'u ono Ya akin naili'il O.
O kam huri we'er Ya'u minle makimaki onno mamani,
la kam hoikaru Num Man Moumou Dewdewe kemen popo.
Papa kukuwedi kalla or'ori dardari Ya'u me'e,
la morle'ule'u morwalwali Ya'u penia Ya akin nahuwa'an wake'e.’

content: Konohiyala I wal'u na'ahoru, nano Daud lirna nonolu onne, ik kauroin mouropo ai kan wakunu ha ma namwali ai kemen mehe, ono Daud onne makiyedi me'e, la nina lunne aile noho eni makun.
Daud namwali nabi, de ai nauroin nahenia Makromod Lalap kikan hopo na'akerhe Nin nou ma na'ahenia nano ai upun anan Ri ida kikan namwali Rai naise Daud haenhi.

Enpenia Daud nauroinedi ha ma namwali lere li'ur penia na'aheni, ‘Kristus onne, Makromod Lalap kikan namwali Rai laa ewi-ewi, la An maki, maa mori wali'ur.’ Daud na'ahenia An maki laedi lunne raram, maa Makromod Lalap kan hoikaru Ai minle makimaki onno, la Ai kemen kan popo lunne raram.
Yesus eni penia Makromod Lalap na'ori wali'ur nano makimaki. Mayai na'akeme mehem do'onedi panaeku onne me'e.

Makromod Lalap kikan Ai naikoro onno man kukulu lalapa lolo Ai herne malanna. Ai Aman nala Roh Kudus Ai naise An nonou eni, de ha mi mehem do'odo'on derderne eniyeni namwali ono Yesus naledi Roh Kudus onne naikoredi mayai honorok akin me'e.
Ik kauroin onne, ono Daud kemen kan ha'a laa a'am lapa raram, maa lolo horok namehin Daud napolu Yesus, ‘Makrom'u’. Ai na'aheni,

content.text: ‘Makromod Lalap na'aheni I Makrom'u: Mai, maikoredi I her'u malanne,
newek hehen nanumene Ya akeperedi Onum arwali enihe, leke O modi molollo hi.’ ”

content: Kame'ede Petrus na'ahenia, “Ende mi ri Israel na'ahoru mauroin kokkoo panaeku eniyeni: Yesus eni man mim wairesne, Makromod Lalap kikan namwali mi Makrommu noro idewe minim Rai (Kristus).”
Hir derne panaeku onneni horu, hi akin woiredi me'e, de ra'ukani Petrus noro hophopon ma nodi Yesus Lirna namehin enihe ra'ahenia, “Mayai lo'o hi'i inhawa?”

Petrus walhale, “Mi dodoho herre minim morimori ma ka namloleni, la derne makani Makromod Lalap. Enla na'amoli mim hurinohi rin nodi oir ulutada mi nodi Yesus Kristus Naran, leke ra'ohu rahaledi minim dohohale, la na'amoli mim lernala Roh Kudus,

ono Makromod Lalap nouwedi me'e na'ahenia Ai nala Roh Kudus mi moro mi upun anumhe, noro idewe ri ma aile noho koko'u enihe. Ik Makromod, Makromod Lalap, nala nou eniyeni ri na'akeme man Ai napolu mai namwali Nin ri.”
Petrus nala panaeku namansa hi leke ken herre hi honorok akin, la napanak an'anhedi na'ahenia, “Mapanak Makromod Lalap huriyedi mi nano ku eniyeni nin honoli man yaka, leke yon An hukum mi.”
Enime'ede ri man kokala Petrus nina wanakunu enihe aki hi na'akeme lo'o ri riwan wokelu. Hi na'akeme rala'a oir raram leke rin ulutade.
Hi onnenihe rampe'el lawuku mamani leke derne rakani hophopon ma nodi Yesus Lirnenihe wakuku. Hi ida ma nala akin ida, la ha'ar roti ra'an romun mamani, la hi'i lir napanak wewerre.

Ri na'akeme lolo Yerusalem heheledi po'on hophopon ma nodi Yesus Lirnenihe hi'i hahaa kar dodo'onnala la ka rauroroinnala makun. Hir horhawa rehi hophopon ma nodi Yesus Lirnenihe ono Makromod Lalap naledi molollo hi me'e.
Ri ma akin naili'il Yesus enihe lawuku mamani, ida man mori wawa'an noro ida, la inhawe man hirira aile hir ha'ar nair wewerre.
Hi ra'olu rira hahaa leke ha'ar wella rale hirira ri man hewhewek nainair kan nokor.

Akilere hir lawuku Makromod Lalap Nina Romleu Lap raram ra'uli rasa'a Oin Naran man kukulu la man lalape. Hir pakromo wuku lolo nakar laa nakar leke ra'ak wewerre noro akin ma nahuwa'anedi, la ida man helkaki ramdaru ida.

Hi ra'uli rasa'a Makromod Lalap mamani, la ri man minle kote onne akin nahuwa'an noro hi. Akilere Makromod Lalap na'uwali ri man lernaledi Nina or'ori dardari ma kan horu eni, penia heri ma akin naili'il Yesus eren na'uwawali.

footnotes.text: Lere onne An ho'ok kail ri mormori na'akeme.
